scenario: Gamma 后端岗电话里，面试官问：「你找工作找得怎么样？有已经排上的 onsite，还是刚开始投？」你有点紧张。
scenario_en: On a Gamma backend call, the interviewer asks, "How are you doing in your search? Do you have onsites coming up, or did you just start searching?"
q_en: How do you respond out loud?
options: How's my job searching? I, I start applying the week before last, so I'm actively exploring opportunities now.
My search status is: recently commenced, currently early-stage, and progressing at an acceptable pace right now.
It's going well — I started a couple weeks ago, so it's early, but I've got a few first-rounds lined up.
Yeah so I started applying the week before last, and I'm actively exploring, and it's early but I'm talking to a few places and prepping and interviewing, so yeah.
tradeoff: 干脆状态句 vs 原样回问：把问题 echo 回去听着卡，代价是显得没准备、还得对方再问一遍。
why: 别把问题原样回问（「How's my job searching?」）。给一句积极、不显焦虑的状态，再加一个具体细节（刚开始、有几个初面），球就接住了。
why_en: Don't echo the question back — give one crisp, upbeat status line plus a small concrete detail, like "early, but I've got a few first-rounds lined up."
whenOtherWins: 如果对方只是顺口寒暄、马上要切入正题，一句「Going well, thanks」就够，不必展开细节。
options_en: How's my job searching? I, I start applying the week before last, so I'm actively exploring opportunities now.
My search status is: recently commenced, currently early-stage, and progressing at an acceptable pace right now.
It's going well — I started a couple weeks ago, so it's early, but I've got a few first-rounds lined up.
Yeah so I started applying the week before last, and I'm actively exploring, and it's early but I'm talking to a few places and prepping and interviewing, so yeah.
optionMeanings: 把问题原样回问，再堆一句模糊状态。
用报告式、书面腔说搜索「状态」。
积极状态 + 一个具体细节。
把时间线和所有动作一股脑倒出来。
optionMeanings_en: Echoes the question back, then a vague status line.
Upbeat status plus one concrete detail.
Dumps the whole timeline and every action at once.
optionScenarioImpacts: echo 让开场卡壳，对方得再问一遍。
书面腔像念稿，不像真人聊天。
对方立刻听到你状态好、有进展。
信息太满显得慌，像在找补。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: Echoing stalls the opener; they have to re-ask.
They immediately hear you're doing fine and moving.
Overloaded info reads as nervous over-explaining.
optionDirectness: 只有没听清、你想复述问题时才用。
只有写邮件汇报进度时才合适。
正合本题——积极、干脆、接住球。
只有对方明确追问细节时才展开。
optionDirectness_en: Only if you misheard and want to repeat it.
Only fits a written status email.
Fits here — warm, crisp, catches the ball.
Only if they explicitly ask for detail.

scenario: 一位招聘人问:「那你现在面试流程走到哪一步了？」上次你答:「still in the early stage... not to the final. final final」，越说越显被动。
scenario_en: A recruiter asks, "Where are you in your job search interview process?" Last time you said, "still in the early stage... not to the final, final final," sounding passive.
q_en: How do you respond out loud?
options: I'm still in the early stage, so I've applied to some roles and have some interviews, but not, not to the final, final final.
I'm early in the process — a few first-rounds going, nothing at final yet, but things are picking up.
The process is presently at a preliminary juncture; several applications remain pending and none have reached a conclusive stage.
So I've applied to a bunch of roles, and some are first rounds, a couple didn't move forward, some I'm waiting on, and none are at final yet, so it's kind of all over the place.
tradeoff: 自信的进行时 vs 强调「还没到 final」:两者事实一样,但「picking up」显得有势头,反复说「not final」显得卡住。
why: 同样是「早期」，说法要有势头:「有几个初面在走、还没到 final，但在加速」。别反复强调「还没到 final final」——那只放大被动感。
why_en: Same "early" facts, but frame momentum: "a few first-rounds going, nothing at final yet, but picking up" — don't keep repeating "not final," which only amplifies passivity.
whenOtherWins: 如果对方在协调档期、真需要知道你离 offer 多近,那就据实说清各家到了哪一轮。
options_en: I'm still in the early stage, so I've applied to some roles and have some interviews, but not, not to the final, final final.
I'm early in the process — a few first-rounds going, nothing at final yet, but things are picking up.
The process is presently at a preliminary juncture; several applications remain pending and none have reached a conclusive stage.
So I've applied to a bunch of roles, and some are first rounds, a couple didn't move forward, some I'm waiting on, and none are at final yet, so it's kind of all over the place.
optionMeanings: 反复强调「还没到 final」，卡词。
早期但带势头的一句话。
把每家的状态和结果全铺一遍。
optionMeanings_en: One line: early, but with momentum.
Lists every company's status and outcome.
optionScenarioImpacts: 反复「not final」放大被动、显得卡。
对方听到早期但在推进，有势头。
书面词让闲聊变冷，不像真人。
过度铺陈显得散乱，还带上了拒信。
optionScenarioImpacts_en: They hear early but advancing, momentum.
Formal words chill the chat, not human.
Over-detail reads as scattered, adds rejections.
optionDirectness: 任何场合都不该这样收尾。
正合本题——早期 + 势头，一句带过。
只有正式书面进度说明才这样写。
只有对方要逐家细节时才铺开。
optionDirectness_en: Never a good way to close this.
Fits here — early plus momentum, one line.
Only for a formal written status note.
Only if they want per-company detail.
